name: io.github.AxelVerneBooks/homelab-pool-front-desk
title: Homelab Pool Front Desk
description: Read-only MCP wrap of a pool-controller API: status and sensors. Companion to MCP for the Homelab.

environmentVariables.name: POOL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the pool-controller (vendor) API.

environmentVariables.name: POOL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the vendor API. Leave empty for unauthenticated/mock APIs.

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the streamable HTTP endpoint listens on.
